expect:
Top band (10-12): Perceptive explanation. E.g. Writing separately (Poem A paragraphs then Poem B paragraphs) only achieves basic comparison, usually limited to a brief ‘both poems show’ conclusion. Comparing throughout means every paragraph addresses both poems, using connectives to draw out similarities and differences in methods, effects, and context. AQA rewards this because it demonstrates deeper understanding — the student sees connections and contrasts in real time, not as an afterthought. Integrated comparison also prevents repetition (you don’t restate ideas) and produces more sophisticated analysis where poets are in dialogue with each other.
Upper-mid band (7-9): Clear explanation.
Lower-mid band (4-6): Basic distinction.
Lower band (1-3): Simple comments.
